text:
alex (prod): Hey all — we need a quick cross-functional touch to resolve the roadmap priority tiebreak for Q3 features. Product wants to push the UX flow, infra has capacity concerns. Can we schedule a 30m call this week to decide and capture a decision log? :calendar:

maya (eng): I can do any afternoon except Thu. Prefer a short agenda: 1) tradeoffs, 2) fallback, 3) decision + owner.

sam (platform): FYI capacity team suggests we avoid big batch jobs the week of 7/22. If the call lands after that window it's easier. @alex can you confirm whether the UX MVP needs rollout before then?

alex (prod): MVP target is end of month but soft — leaning toward earlier if simpler. Not a hard blocker.

jordan (eng-mgr): I can join Tue 3–4p or Wed 10–11a. If we need product/infra leads present, Tue afternoon works best.

lia (design): Wed morning works for me, but Tue afternoon I have a design sync. Can do Tue 3:30–4p if we keep it tight.

alex (prod): OK quick poll. Reply with the letter you prefer. I'll book the slot that gets most votes.
```
A) Tue 3:00–3:30p
B) Tue 3:30–4:00p
C) Wed 10:00–10:30a
D) Wed 10:30–11:00a
E) Fri 11:00–11:30a
```

maya (eng): A

sam (platform): B (can extend to 4 if needed)

jordan (eng-mgr): B

lia (design): C but happy to do B if that's majority

alex (prod): Looks like B wins (3 votes). I'll create a calendar invite and add a short agenda + decision-log doc. CC @ci-bot to pin notes template. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Pinned template created: /docs/decision-logs/decision-template.md

alex (prod): Agenda I'll paste into invite: 1) 5m context, 2) 10m tradeoffs, 3) 10m ops constraints + fallback, 4) 5m decision + owner.

maya (eng): Please also list the acceptance criteria we need for a canary if we pick the UX-first path.

sam (platform): Adding capacity checklist to the doc now.

alex (prod): Thanks — booking Tue 3:30–4:00p, will send invite in 10m. If anyone cannot make it last-minute ping here and we'll do async + decision note.

lia (design): Got the invite, thanks.

jordan (eng-mgr): Got it. If this turns into deeper infra vs product debate, let's extend by 15 and I'll push calendar.

alex (prod): Noted. Aim to keep it 30. See you Tue. :white_check_mark:
